messages:
alexh: Heads-up — opened a PR for the SDK v2 migration guide with updated Python + TS snippets. putting a note about model/quantization sections. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
marie: thanks alex. i'll skim this afternoon. two top asks: consistent terminology (model_id vs modelId) and keep voice technical, not marketing.
sam: FYI release flag for SDK v2 flips WED. can we gate merge until after that?
alexh: yes, planning to wait for release flag. quick blocker: docs preview failing on one code block rendering.
docs-bot: Build #456 failed: docs-preview — markdown render error in migration-guide.md line 142. logs: https://ci.internal/456/logs
priya: probably an unescaped backtick or angle brackets in the TS generic. quick workaround: use explicit type examples or triple-fenced blocks with language. also add sync + async variants for each snippet.
matt: small style nit: our SDK style guide prefers snake_case in examples for Python and camelCase for TS. but in migration guide we should normalize field names to the SDK v2 canonical shape — i.e., model_id for Python examples.
marie: voice guidance: avoid 'you' in intros; use 'engineers' or neutral phrasing. keep comments terse. remove marketing adjectives like 'super' or 'seamless'.
alexh: will update wording and snippet names. question: do we need both docs + sdk approvals per CODEOWNERS?
sam: yes — CODEOWNERS requires at least one docs approver and one SDK reviewer.
alexh: updated commit: fixed code fences, renamed modelId -> model_id in Python examples, added async examples, and swapped one problematic link to the new embeddings page. pushed as force-push.
docs-bot: Build #457 started: docs-preview.
priya: also ran link-checker locally — found one stray reference to the old 'kv-cache' RFC; removed and linked to the runtime overview instead.
matt: TS snippet still uses `modelId` in the callback example — leaving a tiny comment inline to update.
sam: i'm +1 from SDK once that tiny naming nit is resolved.
marie: doing a quick pass on voice now. will approve if comments aligned with style guide.
alexh: great — plan is to wait for both approvals then merge after the release flag flips. if approvals come earlier we hold until the flag. thanks for the rapid reviews :thumbsup:
marie: approving after adjusting one last sentence in the migration intro.
sam: approved.
docs-bot: Build #457 succeeded: docs-preview. preview URL: https://ci.internal/457/preview
alexh: merging after release flag goes green. thanks everyone for the focused feedback — learned notes: add a small checklist in PR template for terminology + snippets, and run link-checker before requesting review.
